name: MADE
summary: Site of MADE, a New Orleans architecture and design firm, with its studio profile, three service lines and a project portfolio.
description: MADE (Merlin Architecture Design, previously One to One Design, founded 2014) is a New Orleans architecture and design firm. The site covers the studio profile, approach and team, a portfolio of architecture projects (Sprout Pediatrics, Poke Loa, Lake Pines Hospital, District Donuts, Lakeshore Drive Cabana, Bloom, Sunset Point Boat House, PCI Human Resources Building, Pelican State Credit Union) and three service lines: architectural design, software + technology consulting, and technical design consulting.
